description_for_human: Entreprise de serrurerie, façades et rénovation intérieure de prestige en Île-de-France
description_for_model: GD Énergie is a French construction company based in Nanterre (92000) specializing in architectural metalwork (serrurerie), curtain wall facades (mur-rideau), waterproofing (étanchéité), roof safety, and premium interior renovation including Little Green paint application, resin floors, and decorative wallpaper. They serve the Paris/Île-de-France region and work with major clients like Chanel, CCI Paris, and Banque Transatlantique. Contact: 06 34 47 76 70, gdanchev@gd-energie.com.
